ROHAN MEHTA
Bengaluru, India | rohan.mehta.dev@gmail.com | +91 98765 43210
linkedin.com/in/rohanmehta-ai | github.com/rohanmehta
Profile Summary
Final-year Computer Science student with hands-on experience across the ML lifecycle, from data preprocessing to fine-tuning and deployment. Comfortable working independently on applied NLP and LLM-based projects.
Skills
Languages: Python, SQL, C++
ML/DL: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers
Tools: Docker, Git, FastAPI, Jupyter, basic AWS
Experience
Machine Learning Intern — Veridian Analytics Pvt. Ltd.
May 2025 – Jul 2025 | Bengaluru
Fine-tuned a text classification model for support ticket categorization, improving accuracy on the internal test set.
Built a small retrieval-based chatbot prototype using LangChain to answer queries from internal documentation.
Containerized model inference code with Docker for easier handoff to the engineering team.
AI Research Assistant (Part-time) — Dept. of Computer Science, R.V. College of Engineering
Jan 2025 – Apr 2025 | Bengaluru
Assisted faculty in benchmarking two open-source LLMs on regional language summarization tasks.
Helped compile and clean a small evaluation dataset used for the benchmarking study.
Projects
DocSense — PDF Question Answering Tool
Built a tool that lets users upload a PDF and ask questions about it, using OpenAI embeddings and FAISS for retrieval.
Used by a few classmates during exam season for quickly searching through lecture notes.
Crop Disease Detector — Computer Vision Model
Trained a CNN (ResNet-50 backbone) to classify 12 crop leaf diseases from images for a college agri-tech project.
Leadership & Activities
Mentored 4 junior students in introductory machine learning concepts through a peer-learning initiative.
Education
B.E. Computer Science Engineering
R.V. College of Engineering, Bengaluru | 2022 – 2026 | CGPA: 8.6/10
Certifications
DeepLearning.AI — Deep Learning Specialization (Coursera)
Hugging Face NLP Course (completed)
